summary: Approximately 923,768 km² and about 211.4 million people (2021), from Wikidata's Q1033 (P2046, P1082). The English Wikipedia article "Nigeria", at revision 1376066185, opens: "Nigeria, officially the Federal Republic of Nigeria, is a country in West Africa between the Sahel to the north and the Gulf of Guinea in the Atlantic Ocean to the south. It covers an area of 923,769 square kilometres (356,669 mi2). With a population of more than 242 million, it is the most populous country in Africa, and the world's sixth-most populous country." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Entity 475 in the Gleditsch–Ward state list, as mapped by CShapes 2.0, a dataset of the borders and capitals of states and dependencies between 1886 and 2019. The dataset gives it 2 periods of territorial validity, from 1960 to where the dataset stops, in 2019. Its last capital in the dataset is Abuja. The code is mapped onto more than one actor (data/imports/cshapes-actors.json); this record holds the periods from 1960-10-01. This record was written by the import from those fields and asserts nothing the dataset does not.
